dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I had no idea that any of this could have been Alice's creation.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Now that I know the truth... there is a certain sweetness to the scenery all around us.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Such a beautiful summer... what could be a better gift?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Oh! Speaking of which... I still have a promise to keep to Klee. Those fish won't blast themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you like to take part in a bit of innocent recreation?
